statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (timing variability in operations intended to be constant-time) is fixed only in crypto-bigint 0.7.6 and later; no fixed 0.5.x release exists. Teleport 17 pulls crypto-bigint 0.5.5 through elliptic-curve 0.13.8, and every elliptic-curve 0.13.x release requires crypto-bigint ^0.5. Only elliptic-curve 0.14 accepts crypto-bigint 0.7, which means moving the p256, p384, p521 and ecdsa crates that picky uses to their breaking 0.14 line. Teleport's desktop access RDP client links these curve crates through picky, which sspi and ironrdp use for CredSSP and certificate handling. Whether the affected operations run on secret data in a way a remote party can time is under review; Teleport 18 already ships crypto-bigint 0.7.6.

crypto-bigint 0.7.6 fixes this advisory; that is a major-version upgrade from 0.5.x.  The bundled copy ships inside the py-rattler build that the base environment installs through conda-rattler-solver. No published py-rattler build bundles a fixed version of this crate yet, so this finding stays under investigation until one does.
